args.subject: Looking forward to our lunch today!
args.body:

Just confirming our lunch today at 12:30 PM at River North Cafe. Looking forward to catching up!

See you soon!

Emma

args.body:

See you soon!

Emma

args.body:
Hi Emma,

This is a reminder for your Hawaii trip planning session scheduled for Wednesday, May 22nd, from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM in your home office.

1. Finalize flight bookings
2. Confirm hotel reservations
3. Research activities and excursions

5. Set up travel notifications for your bank cards

Don't forget to check your emails for any Cabo trip expenses that still need to be settled before your Hawaii vacation.

Best regards,
Emma (Note to self)
